plan.notes:
Per the 2026-2027 Texas A&M University undergraduate catalog: Communication (BS). Prerequisites are not listed in the catalog's plan of study grid; consult course descriptions.
Catalog footnotes:
[grid1 fn1] First semester, first time in college students must take COMM 101 and COMM 291 at Texas A&M University. Do not take SPCH 1311 elsewhere to fulfill this requirement.
[grid1 fn2] Must make a grade of C or better.
[grid1 fn3] Except COMM 100-499.
[grid1 fn4] Select from any 100-499 course not used elsewhere. Includes 12-18 hours of courses used to satisfy the required minor or certificate. Students must earn either a minor to be selected from among university-approved minors or a certificate from among approved Department of Communication and Journalism certificates, which require a grade of B or better in each course. The minor is required unless waived upon completion of the certificate. Consult with an advisor regarding how to declare the desired minor or certificate. Courses fulfilling other requirements may apply to the certificate or the minor; therefore, some of these courses may become general electives.
[grid1 fn5] Select from any 100-499 course not used elsewhere. Includes 12-18 hours of courses used to satisfy the required minor or CMJR certificate and 3-9 hours of general electives. Only 14 hours of KINE 199 ; AERS 100-499; MLSC 100-499; NVSC 100-499; SOMS 100-499 may be used towards general electives.
